scenes.name: home-nav-deep
scenes.note: 30-key Home walk on the benchmark-only addon: 15 down @0.5s, 2s pause, 15 up @0.5s. keyseq spaces keys on the set. Cache state is a GATE concern across boots (run 1 cold, run 2 warm). SMOOTHNESS CONTRACT: from the first key onward at most 15 frames over 22ms and no frame over 40ms; boot/first-mount is reported, not graded. Calibrated against a no-draw control on this set (9-10 frames over 22ms even with all drawing masked), so the gate grades app jank above the hardware floor. 220/300ms ceilings are retained only as gross-regression backstops
